name: Muhammad Raihan Saputra
description: I’m Raihan, a software engineer building full-stack apps, back-office tools and a bit of automation on the side.
summary:
Hi! I’m Muhammad Raihan Saputra, though most people call me by my middle name, Raihan. I’m a software engineer who enjoys building software and thinking about how it should be put together.

I recently finished my Bachelor of Computer Science at [BINUS University](https://binus.ac.id), specializing in Software Engineering, with a 3.66 GPA. Before graduating, I spent a year as an Application Developer Intern at Bank Central Asia (February 2025 to February 2026), building back-office tools for asset and budget management. In 2023, my team also finished in the Top 14 of the Marketeers Innovation Challenge, a national business case competition.

I work across full-stack and backend engineering, and I like automating the tedious parts. I care most about solutions that are practical, and I do my best work in hands-on teams.

Looking for someone to build with? Email me at [muh.raihan.saputra@protonmail.com](mailto:muh.raihan.saputra@protonmail.com). Let’s connect! =)

work.title: Application Developer Intern
work.description: Built back-office tools for asset and budget management in an Agile team, used by 100+ employees across divisions, with OutSystems, JavaScript and Microsoft SQL Server. Shipped a Batch Update feature that imports 200+ asset records from one Excel file in about 24 seconds with transactional rollback, and a Cash Advance Management dashboard that enforces spending limits and audit trails across a 6-stage approval workflow.

projects.title: SEMA
projects.description: A mobile-first web app that turns household electricity readings into bill projections and recommendations, so households can estimate their postpaid bill before the cycle closes. Built for my bachelor’s thesis on decision support systems and evaluated with 76 users.

projects.title: Mystrose
projects.description: A desktop client for automating gameplay in AdventureQuest Worlds, built around a visual block-based scripting language and the interpreter I wrote for it.

projects.title: CaLouselF
projects.description: A desktop marketplace for buying and selling second-hand clothes. I designed the database schema and wrote the backend for listings, transactions and offers.

projects.title: Signtro
projects.description: A web app for learning sign language through courses and a computer-vision gesture guide. I built the course interface and content flow, and integrated the gesture recognition module.

projects.title: Mapper
projects.description: A tool that extracts map data from AdventureQuest Worlds, recovering hard-to-reach cell and pad labels in seconds and exporting them for Mystrose and other community tools.
